ownerDecision: Open S3-CA now as the Docking Center product experience without creating a parallel Core, Store, Receipt or permanent Agent.
completionSentence: T5는 현재 연결·설치·권한·실측과 아직 준비되지 않은 후보를 작은 Capability Reality에서 구분하고, 모델 판단용 Dock Knowledge와 Runtime 집행용 Machine Manifest를 분리하며, 획득·계정 연결·운영 lifecycle을 한 success로 합치지 않는다.

comparatorSourceAudit.observed: bounded manifest loading, source-root checks and activation contracts, but a broad plugin runtime surface
plugin manifest and scanner separation, but pass/warn/fail classification and in-process Python plugin execution

qualified: The existing S3-CA source of truth is active; no new Docking plan document or canonical ledger was created.
Dock Knowledge contains bounded model-facing summary, constraints and exact official source facts but has no executable authority.

Machine Manifest independently binds immutable source, publisher, digest, license, platform, separate-process entrypoint, auth owner, scopes, exact action hosts and effects, closed input schemas, dependency digests, isolation, declarative lifecycle and qualification probe.
A single trust level, arbitrary lifecycle hooks, in-process extension execution, credential-bearing documentation URLs and open action schemas fail closed.
Acquisition, account connection and operational lifecycle remain three independent axes; the small derived reality never replaces them.
Current connected, needs-auth, degraded and preparable candidates are projected together without upgrading catalog candidates to usable_now.
Capability Reality is absent from the normal model tool surface and opens through tool_search only after the model identifies a capability gap.
The runtime does not branch on service names or select the method.
